task_completion.description: At least 2 partition walls are constructed to separate the washing and break rooms from the main floor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for new wall segments in the 2D plan or 3D view that create enclosed or semi-enclosed spaces for the wash station and break room.

task_completion.description: At least 6 styling stations (each with a chair and desk/table) are placed on the styling floor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count at least 6 pairs of chairs and desks/tables arranged in the main styling area in the 3D view or 2D plan.

task_completion.description: Reception area includes a desk, 3 waiting seats, and 4 retail display shelves.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify a desk, 3 distinct chairs/seats for waiting, and 4 shelving units in the designated reception zone.

task_completion.description: Washing zone has at least 2 sinks; break room has at least 1 kitchen appliance.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Locate 2 sink objects in the wash area and at least one appliance (e.g., fridge, microwave, stove) in the break room.

task_completion.description: At least 3 different floor colors/textures applied; 4 light fixtures and 3 plants placed.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check for distinct floor patterns/colors in 3 zones. Count 4 lamps/lights and 3 plant models throughout the salon.

task_completion.description: At least 4 text labels (e.g., 'Reception', 'Styling Floor', 'Wash Station', 'Break Room') are visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for text overlays or labels in the 2D floor plan identifying the different functional areas.
Look for the 'Save As' dialog box with the correct path/filename or the filename appearing in the Sweet Home 3D title bar.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place objects and modify the environment.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, the 2D plan, and the 'Modify Room' or 'Modify Wall' dialogs.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-existing completed file but actively placed elements.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots should show the gradual addition of furniture, walls, and labels over time.

integrity.description: The agent did not use terminal commands to bypass the design software's interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal should not show commands that programmatically generate .sh3d XML content or move files to the destination without GUI interaction.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent starts with a file named 'hair_salon_project.sh3d'. It must add 6 styling stations (chair+desk), 1 reception desk, 3 waiting seats, 4 retail shelves, 2 sinks, 1 kitchen appliance, 2 partition walls, 3 floor textures, 4 lights, 3 plants, and 4 text labels. The final file must be saved as 'salon_design.sh3d' in /home/ga/Documents/.
